entries.08ce208e592401e5: The business sells metal flatware such as knives and forks, ceramics and tableware to department stores, mass merchandisers, wedding venues, banquet halls and hotels. It handles the tableware brand "DANSK," originating in Denmark, its own brand "D&S," and products designed by industrial designer Sori Yanagi. It also conducts a retail business that expands directly operated outlet stores, plans and sells promotional products, and handles TV shopping and mail-order sales. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased 18.0% from the previous year. The reasons include firm sales of its own products.
entries.1df3e283246d300d: A business that purchases steel materials such as steel plates and bars and sells them to manufacturers of automobiles, construction machinery and the like. Each business site has a warehouse and also performs 1st-stage processing such as cutting. Kanagawa, Tochigi and Koriyama have coil centers (sites that process coiled steel sheet and ship it). Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 1.2% from the previous fiscal year. The main reason given is that although sales to the commercial vehicle and construction and industrial machinery industries were firm, material prices fell. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, it is the business with the largest net sales to external customers among the 6 businesses.

It also proposes factory automation. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 9.2% from the previous year, as there had been large projects in the previous year, among other reasons.
entries.a9e2d0ddb5a56168: The business sells materials used in components of electronic devices. It sells electronic materials, such as laminates for printed wiring boards used in AI servers, in-vehicle equipment and various electronic and electrical products, as well as liquid crystal and electronic components, mainly to the telecommunications infrastructure and automotive industries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased 20.8% from the previous year. The reasons are that, against the backdrop of the expansion of the generative AI market, materials and components for telecommunications infrastructure were strong, and that exports of materials for semiconductors, liquid crystals and HDDs and new orders for components and processed products increased significantly. Revenue from external customers is the second largest after the Steel Business.
entries.b18bcc94bc4adab9: The business sells materials and processed products of non-ferrous metals, such as aluminum and zinc. It sells to industries including automobiles, machinery manufacturing and die casting (a method of making parts by pouring metal into molds). In some cases, it also sells ingots and automotive parts procured overseas in Japan and abroad. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 decreased 3.1% from the previous year. The reason was weak sales of commercial vehicles to Southeast Asia, while parts sales for construction and industrial machinery were firm.
